step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify nodes: Spot.io side has EC2 (Data Collector), Aurora (Data Store), SageMaker (ML), and EKS (SaaS Management). Client side has CloudFormation (Deployment), IAM (Cross-account role), EKS (Client Cluster), and Spot Instances (Client EC2 nodes).
2. Trace edges based on visual arrowheads and transcript context:
   - EC2 (Spot.io) -> Aurora (Data Collection storage)
   - SageMaker -> Aurora (Reads/analyzes data for predictions)
   - EKS (Spot.io) -> Aurora (SaaS application backend queries)
   - EKS (Spot.io) -> IAM (Cross-account access via IAM role)
   - CloudFormation -> IAM (Deploys cross-account role/policy)
   - IAM -> EKS (Client) (Grants access to manage client EKS)
   - EKS (Client) -> EC2 Spot Instances (Manages/replaces worker nodes)
